description: Water Treatment Plant Data, Gladstone Area Water Board is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gladstone Area Water Board. •Raw Water delivered to GWTP and YWTP •Volumetric water treated at GWTP and YWTP •Turbity GWTP and YWTP •Free Chlorine GWTP and YWTP Volumetric water treated is the amount of water pumped out of the treatment plants as final drinking water. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Gladstone Area Water Board. Its tags are Gladstone, Water. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
